overview: Built an automated lead management workflow that captures new form submissions, checks lead status, updates the CRM, notifies the team, and manages follow up communication.

list: Finds or creates the contact in GoHighLevel
Checks whether the lead is new
Adds the lead to Google Sheets
Creates a follow up task in Asana

blocks.p: For existing leads, the system checks the last contact date and routes the lead based on the result.
If the lead has not been contacted for more than 30 days:

list: Adds the lead to a re engagement list

blocks.p: If the lead was contacted within 30 days:

list: Adds a note to the GoHighLevel contact
Creates a follow up reminder in GoHighLevel

result: An automated lead handling system that manages new and existing leads, keeps the CRM updated, notifies the team, and ensures follow ups are created without manual tracking.
